title: Card Deck Batching
description: You are managing a collectible card game inventory. A batch of cards has been shuffled together, where each card has a numerical rank represented by the integer array cards. You need to divide all the cards in the inventory into groups of size group_size such that each group contains consecutive ranks (i.e., card, card + 1, card + 2, ..., card + group_size - 1). Return true if you can successfully partition all the cards into such groups, or false otherwise.
input_format: An integer array cards and an integer group_size.

examples.explanation: The cards can be partitioned into [1, 2, 3], [2, 3, 4], and [6, 7, 8].
The total number of cards is 5, which is not divisible by 4, so equal groups of size 4 are impossible.
Even though there are 3 cards, they do not form a consecutive sequence.
